definitions.explanation: With little effort or trouble. Often used in negative sentences to imply that something is not as easy as it might seem.

examples.japanese: たやすく⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It's not something that can be done easily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たやすく⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たやすく⟦{変|か}えられる→変える：01089_kaeru⟧もので⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Long-standing habits are not something that can be changed easily.

notes:
たやすく is the adverbial form of the i-adjective ⟦たやすい→たやすい：10401_tayasui⟧ (easy, simple). It has a slightly more literary or elevated tone compared to ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. The word is often used in negative contexts to emphasize difficulty.

USAGE:
More common in written language and formal speech than in casual conversation. Frequently appears in negative constructions: たやすく～⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧, たやすく～⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- たやすく⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|い}る: easily obtained
- たやすく⟦{想像|そうぞう}できる→想像する：06060_souzousuru⟧: easy to imagine
- たやすく⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: believe readily
- ⟦たやすい→たやすい：10401_tayasui⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: it is no easy matter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: easily — the most common and neutral equivalent; used in both spoken and written language
- ⟦{容易|ようい}→容易：12316_youi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: easily — formal and written; similar register to たやすく
- ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: easily; comfortably — emphasizes comfort and lack of strain
